The Compute Stack (compute.openie.dev) [E/M/S · measured_j]

Maps 258 primitives across 33 families while qualifying its primary hardware anchor: 11,428 pJ/cycle (11.43 nJ, SE=129 pJ, N=4 25s passes) is a whole-SOM KV260 INA260 reading; 98 pJ seed delta is inconclusive.

1/2 Shunt anchors vs analytical cells:
- KV260 VCC_SOM (PS+PL+DDR+regs) 11.43 nJ/cycle & Thor INA3221 162.56 nJ/op LUT6 / 927.30 uJ verify are measured_j
- Zen 5 20.07x & Core i9 15.44x prelude cuts are Linux RAPL reported_j
- 257/258 portal cells are Horowitz/analytical [M/S]

2/2 Sensor floor & toolchain status:
- 98.0 pJ (~1.96 mA at 5V) sits near INA260's 1.25 mA LSB and needs an isolated VCCINT Kelvin shunt
- Portal jlandauer CLI is a private prototype; open RTL replication uses Yosys + openXC7 + Verilator in lut-adapt-ai (Apache-2.0)
